lk-1YKV.title: Language: Tamil script means north, east or hills
lk-1YKV.summary: Tamil script goes with Hindu areas: Sri Lankan Tamils in the north and east, and Indian Tamils around the central hills. Two-language signs appear everywhere, but Tamil-only signs point to those areas.

lk-2p9M.title: Coverage: low-quality camera, wide round blur
lk-2p9M.summary: A low-quality camera with a wide circular car blur and often brownish colours. Rarely used on good maps. India, Cambodia, Ecuador and to a lesser extent Bangladesh have the same type.

lk-52lk.title: Landscape: hilly plains of long grass
lk-52lk.summary: Hilly open plains covered in long grass, with forests in the distance. Roads wind through wide open land. This is a national park.

lk-5SaV.title: Tuktuk: bulky body with black roof
lk-5SaV.summary: A bulky tuktuk with a black roof, usually green, yellow or red, though other colours exist.

lk-5c1p.title: Plants: tea plantations in rows on hillsides
lk-5c1p.summary: Small bright green shrubs planted in tidy rows on hillsides. They are in the centre and south-west, mostly just west of the central hill town.

lk-7b7h.title: Road lines: edge lines but no centre line
lk-7b7h.summary: Rural roads often have lines on the edges but none in the middle. It can help with a tough 50-50 guess. Most small roads have no lines at all.

lk-A0Tf.title: Houses: orange-red tiled roofs, worn brownish
lk-A0Tf.summary: Houses often have orange or red tiled roofs that look almost brown from wear. Similar roofs are common in parts of Indonesia.

lk-AYFb.title: Pole: concrete, pinholes at top or big holes below
lk-AYFb.summary: Concrete poles of two kinds: square with small pinholes only near the top, or with large see-through holes in the lower half. The big-holes type is found only here.

differs.how: Thai square poles have pinholes all the way to the bottom

lk-CFoL.title: Sign: Hindu, Muslim and Christian sites
lk-CFoL.summary: A sizeable minority is Hindu (13%), Muslim (10%) or Christian (7%). Each is concentrated in certain regions, shown on the religion maps.

lk-HCRR.title: Landscape: lush green, patchwork fields
lk-HCRR.summary: A tropical country with very green vegetation. It is densely populated, and many areas look like a patchwork of farm fields.

lk-I2B3.title: Sign: Buddhist temples, statues and flags
lk-I2B3.summary: Around 70% are Buddhist, so you often see temples, Buddha statues, stupas and the Buddhist flag. Thailand, Cambodia and Laos are also majority Buddhist.

lk-JSpS.title: Vegetation: lower, brown-green elsewhere
lk-JSpS.summary: Outside the south-west it is slightly drier: lower, more open vegetation with brown and green tones. The difference is small and the older Gen 3 camera can make it look drier than it is.

lk-QMG3.title: Google car: low camera, big car blur
lk-QMG3.summary: The newer Gen 4 coverage uses a camera set lower than usual: a much bigger car blur, wider-looking roads and objects seen from a low angle. The older Gen 3 coverage is normal height.

differs.how: Also low camera, but landscape differs
Also low camera, but landscape differs

lk-UbLa.title: Phone numbers: 10 digits, area code starts with 0
lk-UbLa.summary: Phone numbers have 10 digits. Landlines begin with a three-digit area code starting with 0, which points to a region on the map. Mobile numbers start with 07 and have no region.

lk-Vtwe.title: Google car: blue-white-red patches in the blur
lk-Vtwe.summary: In the older Gen 3 coverage (blurrier, softer colours), the car front shows through the blur as blue, white and red patches like a French flag; the red is clearest. Ghana's car looks similar but has a roof rack.

differs.how: Ghana's similar car also has a roof rack

lk-YaPp.title: Route marker: tall white stone with yellow number
lk-YaPp.summary: A tall white concrete marker with a dent near the bottom holding a yellow road number. Found only here.

lk-Yl3z.title: Bollard: short wide stone, black base, white top
lk-Yl3z.summary: A short, wide tapered stone bollard with a black base and a white top. Found only here.

lk-fnRY.title: Plants: very common palm trees
lk-fnRY.summary: Palm trees are very common, more than in most Asian countries. They are also very common in the Philippines.

lk-l3FA.title: Landscape: reddish soil
lk-l3FA.summary: Many areas have reddish soil. White sandy soil appears less often.

lk-lm-15830.title: Pole: mushroom-shaped insulators
lk-lm-15830.summary: The ceramic insulators on utility poles very commonly look like mushrooms.

lk-mWPv.title: Sign: black and white striped signposts
lk-mWPv.summary: Signposts are painted in black and white stripes. The same style appears in Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal and Malaysia.

lk-oQcO.title: Plate: long white front, short yellow rear
lk-oQcO.summary: Cars have a long white plate at the front and a short yellow plate at the back.

lk-obMz.title: Language: round Sinhala and straight-lined Tamil
lk-obMz.summary: Sinhala script is very curvy and rounded and found everywhere. Tamil has straighter lines and is more regional. English also appears. Tamil also appears in southern India.

differs.how: Tamil also appears in the state of Tamil Nadu

lk-wS9v.title: Region: hills are in the south-centre
lk-wS9v.summary: Hills and mountains are mostly in the central-southern part of the country.

lk-wbsP.title: Vegetation: very green and wet in the south-west
lk-wbsP.summary: The south-west has a wetter climate with lush, dense vegetation in deep green tones.

lk-yZrO.title: Region: where each religion is found
lk-yZrO.summary: Buddhism covers most of the country except the north and parts of the east coast. Hinduism is in the north, parts of the east and near the central mountains. Islam is strongest on the east coast. Christianity is mostly in the north-west.
